1) the design of a prosthetic arm or hand is a complex problem, requiring the integration of many different components and subsystems; 2) the design of prosthetic arms and hands must be approached as a systems engineering problem, and not simply as a problem of designing a terminal device; and 3) the design of the terminal device must be approached as an integrated problem, and not as a problem of selecting the best terminal device and then integrating it into a prosthesis.
